effect.instructions: Imagine this image as a full-bleed frame from a broadcast or theatrical hand-drawn Japanese animated film of the 1990s. How convincing is that specific visual treatment? Look for opaque, uniform cel-painted flats, sharply bounded simple shadow shapes and consistent ink contours on foreground forms where visible, plus a separately painted background or a stylized background painting suitable as a cel-animation establishing shot. Consider the visible palette and optical softness only as supporting evidence. An ink-and-watercolor drawing on textured or bordered paper, pencil sketch, poster, or illustration with watercolor bleeding throughout does not itself establish the cel animation treatment. A person need not be present.
criteria: The medium and overall treatment read as a different kind of image, including a sketch, watercolor on paper, glossy 3D, or photography.
A few illustrative features evoke animation, but the rendered frame lacks the specific hand-drawn cel treatment.
The image mostly looks like an animated cel-era frame, with clear opaque graphic shapes, controlled shadows and/or an animation background.
An unmistakable, coherent 1990s hand-drawn cel-animation frame, with a convincing production palette, graphic shapes and painted treatment throughout.
